home.title: Fire, butter, and plates meant to be shared.
home.lede: In the evening the table sits beside the hearth.
home.signaturesLede: The plates shared most often at dinner.
home.storyLede: Evening service in Karaköy is built around the hearth, butter, and plates meant to be shared. The kitchen opens at 17:00 and closes at 23:15.
home.galleryLede: The dining room, the hearth, and the evening table.
home.closeTitle: Save a table for the evening.

story.title: Beside the fire
story.lead: Evening service is set up right beside the hearth.
story.p1: The table sits close to the fire. Plates come to the middle and are shared: coals, butter, and thin bread.
story.p2: The grill cooks over the embers, with sumac onions, charred peppers, and salad. Dessert and tea close the meal.
story.p3: The doors open Wednesday at 17:00 and close Sunday at midnight. We are closed Monday and Tuesday. The kitchen takes its last order at 23:15.
story.close: Kemankeş Cad. No 18, Karaköy. Save a table for the evening.
